title: For tech all you need is an old phone, a multidirectional bluetooth mic, and a tripod (tripod optional duct tape can do). You stream write to YouTube
summary: For tech all you need is an old phone, a multidirectional bluetooth mic, and a tripod (tripod optional duct tape can do). You stream write to YouTube Live. We could do it all under $200. I do this same set up all the time. #lra18
author: Greg McVerry
